name: Macquarie University
summary: Sydney university in Macquarie Park with faculties of Arts, Business, Medicine and Health, and Science and Engineering.

ib.text: Entry is on your IB total, converted by Macquarie to an international selection rank per program. The conversion tables are on its academic requirements page; Coursefinder lists each program's rank and prerequisites.

apply.via: Direct to Macquarie or an authorised agent

notes: IB students outside Australia apply directly to Macquarie or through an authorised agent; UAC is only for an IB Diploma completed in Australia.
Macquarie offers an International Academic Entry Program for applicants who do not meet a program's minimum score, considering English and maths results.
In some circumstances Macquarie accepts applications only through an authorised agent.

sources.title: Macquarie: Academic entry requirements for international students
